title: 基本计算器
summary: 计算包含整数、加减号、括号和空格的有效表达式。
insight: 维护当前括号层的累计结果、正在读取的数和符号；遇到左括号时保存外层状态，右括号时合并。
pitfalls: 一元负号可由初始 sign=-1 处理
表达式末尾的数字必须结算

solutions.title: 结果与符号栈
solutions.idea: 扫描字符并在运算符和括号处结算数字。
steps: 加减号先把 sign*number 加入 result
左括号压入 result/sign 并重置，右括号结算后合并

code.java: class Solution { public int calculate(String s){int result=0,number=0,sign=1;Deque<Integer> stack=new ArrayDeque<>();for(char c:s.toCharArray()){if(Character.isDigit(c))number=number*10+c-'0';else if(c=='+'||c=='-'){result+=sign*number;number=0;sign=c=='+'?1:-1;}else if(c=='('){stack.push(result);stack.push(sign);result=0;sign=1;}else if(c==')'){result+=sign*number;number=0;result*=stack.pop();result+=stack.pop();}}return result+sign*number;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun calculate(s:String):Int{var result=0;var number=0;var sign=1;val stack=ArrayDeque<Int>();for(c in s){when{c.isDigit()->number=number*10+(c-'0');c=='+'||c=='-'->{result+=sign*number;number=0;sign=if(c=='+')1 else -1};c=='('->{stack.addLast(result);stack.addLast(sign);result=0;sign=1};c==')'->{result+=sign*number;number=0;result*=stack.removeLast();result+=stack.removeLast()}}};return result+sign*number} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int calculate(string s){int result=0,number=0,sign=1;vector<int> stack;for(char c:s){if(isdigit(c))number=number*10+c-'0';else if(c=='+'||c=='-'){result+=sign*number;number=0;sign=c=='+'?1:-1;}else if(c=='('){stack.push_back(result);stack.push_back(sign);result=0;sign=1;}else if(c==')'){result+=sign*number;number=0;result*=stack.back();stack.pop_back();result+=stack.back();stack.pop_back();}}return result+sign*number;} };
